notes.title: "Groovy Update" comming!!
notes.content:
There is big update named "Groovy Update" and affect game play.

[h1]New Feature [i]Groove Chance[/i][/h1]

The red colored "Groove Gauge" that indicated at bottom circle will increase when press button without notes.
[b]Groove Chance[/b] will start when the gauge filled!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35205002/035ad11554ca566c8b5168001f6bea004f47818f.jpg[/img]

The player can beat notes in own rhythm.
But monotonous rhythm cause end of Groove Chance.

[h1]New Feature [i]Drift[/i][/h1]

Reset the junction state by [b]Drift Button[/b]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35205002/75a8af97a42f9cb54fe8bc72c4526a55754b1de0.jpg[/img]

[h1]Junction completion rate[/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35205002/52bf821ed80d347306290cadc39e25aaa8ccac47.jpg[/img]

[h1]Other fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Interface adjustment
[*]All notes vanish when Deviation, and all taps treat as note tap success, and combo count increase.
[*]R Trigger stops notes while current wave only.
[*]Secret Beats will be visible when Tension is Crazy.
[*]bug fixes
[/list]

notes.title: Next Content Update - Jul/2019
notes.content:

[list]
[*]Accidents occur when DanceHoleTime
[*]DanceHoleTime Tutorial occurs at the wrong timing. (In some cases, need restart game)
[*]Mission List in stage select menu can not scroll down.
[/list]

[h1]Game balance adjustment[/h1]
[list]

[*]New feature "Drift"
[*]New feature "Groove Chance"
[*]All notes vanish when Deviation, and all taps treat as note tap success, and combo count increase.
[*]Secret Beats will be visible when Tension is Crazy.
[*]Tension increase easily.
[/list]

[h1]Scenario[/h1]
[list]
[*]Add text skip system.
[*]Change some words.
[/list]
